calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, sum(o.order_total_gross) gross, min(CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) min_ord, max(CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) max_ord
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-12' AND DATE '2025-12-26'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, count(*) c, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) e1, max(f.etl_loaded_at) e2, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM w) orders,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM l)) orders_no_lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM l) lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE c>1) dup_keys,
       (SELECT sum(net) FROM l) net_all,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT CAST(e2 AS DATE)) FROM l) load_days,
       (SELECT min(e1) FROM l) first_load, (SELECT max(e2) FROM l) last_load,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') web_returns,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM w)) test_lines

SELECT sum(r.refund_net) refund_net_in_stores, count(*) n,
 (SELECT sum(r2.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r2 JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r2.store_key WHERE s2.store_id=900 AND r2.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') refund_net_booked_to_900
